==Description==
'''April Fools 2020''' was the first April Fools update that was added to the game on the 1st of April 2020, and was removed from the game on the 2nd of April 2020. It replaced all humanoid towers' faces with random joke faces. While this was the main joke, a secondary side joke was changing the icon and name of the game to "Welcome to Tower Defense Simulator!" (a parody of the Roblox game ''Welcome to Bloxburg'').

==Tower Gallery==
Non-humanoid towers such as the [[Turret]] (excluding the {{Color|Premium|XR500}} skin) and [[Sentry]] did not have a funny face. Other towers like the [[Paintballer]] had a funny face, but it was concealed by either a hat or mask.
